array.string: mkdir -p /var/log/bepr if [ -f /etc/bepr/server.conf ] && [ -f /etc/bepr/client.conf ]; then echo "both /etc/bepr/server.conf and /etc/bepr/client.conf exist; keep exactly one" >&2 exit 1 elif [ -f /etc/bepr/server.conf ]; then exec /usr/local/bin/bepr server >>/var/log/bepr/server.log 2>&1 elif [ -f /etc/bepr/client.conf ]; then exec /usr/local/bin/bepr client >>/var/log/bepr/client.log 2>&1 else echo "missing /etc/bepr/server.conf or /etc/bepr/client.conf" >&2 exit 1 fi
